### Rulings that bind ###
- **R1 Euro known.** In `vinlab/decoder.py`, the euro is known only when the applied `vref.db` row (after the
  T-VINA-3 window check) has a `euro_norm` that `_EURO_MAP` recognises. Otherwise it is unknown. The emitted
  `euro_emission_category` stays `EURO_1` when unknown: the contract enum (`SEMANTIC_CONTRACT.md` §6.4) has no
  unknown value, and COMLab reads `resolved_horizon` first (`comlab/projection.py`,
  `comlab/core/horizon_context_injector.py`).
- **R2 Horizon.** Euro unknown and model year known: `resolved_horizon` is `_year_to_horizon(model_year)`. Euro unknown
  and no model year: `HORIZON_LEGACY`, as today. Euro known: `euro_to_horizon(euro)`, as today.
- **R3 Stress RPM.** Euro unknown: `stress_idle_rpm` gets no euro value, so its horizon fallback applies (the
  "euro absent" path, `labs/vinlab/docs/LLD_VINLab.md` § 9). Euro known: unchanged.
- **R4 Flag.** Euro unknown adds the confidence flag `euro_unknown`. P1: it changes no real VIN's confidence. The plan
  names every test fixture whose confidence it changes.
- **R5 Citation (F-D1-13).** A new section `## 10.8 Era from model year when the euro norm is unknown` in
  `labs/vinlab/wiki/10_decode_scope_rules.md` states the bands 1990-2000 LEGACY, 2001-2010 ADAPTIVE, 2011 and later
  MODERN. It settles the edges of `labs/comlab/wiki/04_horizon_eras.md` ("pre-1997 → ~2001", "~2001–2011"): Euro 3 is
  compulsory for every new petrol car registered from 2001-01-01 (Directive 98/69/EC), and Euro 5 from 2011-01-01
  (Regulation (EC) No 715/2007). It states that a model year is not a registration date (a 1-year fuzz at each edge).
  Each year literal in `horizon.py::_year_to_horizon` cites that section (`# wiki: …`). The docstring of
  `horizon.py` drops "Used only when euro_emission_category is unknown" only if the plan shows a second caller.
